superseded_attempts.why_invalid: All thresholds pass: 0.8 >= 0.8, 0.75 >= 0.7, and margin 0.75 - 0.25 = 0.50 >= 0.20. Kept as historical attempt only.

fixture_rules.response_materialization: R-FULL-VALID-BASELINE is the complete semantically valid request/response pair. q-choice request criteria and response keys are yes/no; q-noul is in [0,1]; q-score probabilities, expectation and legend agree; required usage counts and optional cost are valid. Every later case repeats the complete request and response with baseline_id and changed_json_paths. Each negative mutates only its named response path(s); optional-omission and unknown-extra controls are independently valid.
fixture_rules.assessment_materialization: prepared_args is complete DecisionArgs. Policy ID/type cases target prepare semantic validation before assessment. A-POLICY-VALID-ID is the existing-ID positive; A-POLICY-BAD-ID changes only the external map key to absent-question while preserving a valid Choice rule; A-POLICY-BAD-TYPE uses existing q-choice with a form-valid Noul rule, so only type correspondence fails. No assessment is invoked for prepare errors.
fixture_rules.usage_contract: R-FULL-VALID-BASELINE has mandatory nonnegative integer input_tokens/output_tokens and valid optional cost. R-MINIMAL-OPTIONAL-OMITTED retains both counts. R-MISSING-USAGE, R-USAGE, R-USAGE-OUTPUT-TOKENS, and R-USAGE-COST independently target absent usage, negative input count, negative output count, and negative cost.
fixture_rules.non_finite: JSON cannot encode NaN/Infinity. The direct-call companion constructs Number.NaN and Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY after JSON.parse, then invokes response validation with the same prepared_request; expected UPSTREAM_PROTOCOL.
